description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'TimesheetProjectActivityUniqueValidationAPI' used to validate the uniqueness of a project activity within a timesheet in the OrangeHRM Time module. It handles a GET request to check if a specified project activity is a duplicate in the context of a particular timesheet, utilizing external services and traits for timesheet management and permission checks.

classes.name: TimesheetProjectActivityUniqueValidationAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating the uniqueness of project activities within a timesheet, providing GET method implementation and validation rules.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles the GET request to validate if a project activity is a duplicate for a given timesheet by fetching parameters, validating the timesheet existence and accessibility, and returning the duplication status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request parameters, ensuring 'timesheetId', 'projectId', and 'activityId' are positive integers.
